title: Dropping new game ideas here weekly. Week 2: Digtionary
author: StaticAnchor
selftext:
I'm all in on building games.

This has been the most fun I've ever had as someone with a product design background. So many opportunities to focus on how to make games feel more..fun.

Mobile games suck. So bad. Dopamine cash grabs that go..no where. There's no depth, no meaning. Even the "depth" is shallow.

I fell in love with Balatro a couple years ago, and wish so many more mobile games were like that. Mobile games don't have to suck. They can and SHOULD be deeply fun, and I don't think there's ever been a better time to help build up truly fun games.

I'm focusing on building small toys that I want people to get sucked into and feel a real sense of progression and mastery. To feel the thrill of figuring out how to beat the machine.

This weeks game is a word building roguelite called Digtionary, where you help Doug dig deep into the earth and collect letters to build words. Create combos and get enough points to move on to the next level.

Any feedback is always weclome. Play it for free on itch, recommended for mobile.

[https://hookandsinkergames.itch.io/digtionary](https://hookandsinkergames.itch.io/digtionary)
